key_insight: DFT-trained machine-learning force fields can capture the finite-temperature martensitic dynamics of Ni2MnGa, including soft phonons and nanotwinned modulated martensites.
engineering_relevance: This enables near-DFT-accuracy simulations of magnetic shape memory alloys over larger length and time scales, supporting alloy design for actuators and adaptive smart materials.
method: Trained machine-learning force fields on DFT ab initio molecular dynamics data.
Ran classical molecular dynamics to simulate austenite–martensite transformation dynamics.
Analyzed phonon softening and twin-boundary energetics across the transformation path.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the ML-FF reproduces the soft TA2 phonon, predicts a preference for nanotwinned martensites, and matches the DFT-predicted negative twin-boundary energy along the full T=0 transformation path.
watch_item: The force field is only as reliable as its DFT training set, so transferability to compositions, temperatures, or strain states outside the training regime should be validated.
paper_title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
